method: Two pre-skin POSITION targets. Actual LBS at 10/20 degrees, per-vertex inverse blended linear map, compact fixed-exterior support and complete-hand pad domains. No pose, bone, weight or hip topology changes.
runtime_vs_predicted_boundary: Baseline actual loaded-GLB samples establish the motion-input reconstruction tolerance. Corrected output is numerical standard LBS with float32 morph deltas; parent must read back the eventual GLB independently.
binding_input: motion-input.json plus explicitly hashed sparse runtime-weight-override

support_keypose_initializer.method: Single fixed-core vertical graph-Laplacian least-squares field; posed offsets are inverse-transported by each vertex's actual blended linear map.

hand.method: One bounded three-coordinate pad-compression solve; complete conservative hand-face barycentric quadrature against the fixed actual leg skin, normalized graph-Laplacian regularization, explicit per-vertex source-space 8 mm balls.

baseline_hip_failure_not_owned_or_certif: Tiny groin folds are a separate harmonic-binding pilot; this support/contact pass cannot establish whole-body or hip acceptance.
global_baseline_contact_disclosure: Existing axilla/knee/hip contacts are reported separately. No whole-body intersection-free claim.
